department: Astronomy Unit, Department of Physics and Astronomy (School of Physical and Chemical Sciences)

deadline.value: Studentship applications for the Astronomy Unit close on 28 January, for STFC and China Scholarship Council funding. The page shows the 2026 date, so 2027 is inferred.
deadline.quote: To be considered for an STFC or China Scholarship Council studentship applications should be submitted by 28th January 2026 for entry in the following academic year

also.quote: Applications made after that date may still be considered for studentships depending on availability.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must identify a potential supervisor and contact them first. Once they agree to consider your application, you apply formally, naming the supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Before applying, you will need to identify a potential supervisor for your PhD. | Once you have contacted a potential supervisor, and they have agreed to consider your application further, you will be required to make a formal application.

also.quote: we recommend contacting potential supervisors in advance of your application

funding.value: Most funding is through advertised studentships (STFC, China Scholarship Council and others), which are competitive.
funding.quote: Other studentship opportunities sometimes arise at other times of year, and will be advertised on this web site.

entry_route.value: The normal minimum is an upper second class honours degree in physics, astronomy, mathematics or a subject with substantial physics or maths content. No master's is mentioned.
entry_route.quote: The normal minimum entry requirement is an upper second class honours degree in Physics, Astronomy or Astrophysics, Mathematics, or in a subject with substantial physics and/or mathematics content.

ielts_min.value: The Astronomy Unit page states IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with 6.0 in writing and 5.5 in the other skills.
ielts_min.quote: Academic IELTS: 6.5 overall, with a minimum of 6.0 in writing and a minimum of 5.5 in reading, speaking and listening

notes: Same department and school application process as the physics record. The Astronomy Unit has its own programme code.
name: Astronomy Unit PhD
